assumptions.host_path: example nominal host memory 64GB/s, vector 50Gops/s, H2D 32GB/s; replace with host parameters
assumptions.kernel_invocations: A5 9582 ordinary vector1.312us and Cube1.578us are engineering class extrapolations from nonempty BF16 library controls. Explicit empty_aic retains0.439us; explicit w8a8_nd_bf16 carries3.037us for the declared INT8 ND row/channel-scale BF16 MIX_AIC boundary, never inferred for NZ/W4/MXFP8/grouped kernels. Inclusive completion minima, zero startup; runtime rules and explicit classes override defaults.
assumptions.launch_us: host submission is undeclared, so launch_us=0 is the device-path baseline, not a measured host launch; runtime.submission.kernel_launch_ms or an explicit device.launch_us can declare host submission; an empty-task duration is not used as a host parameter
assumptions.matrix_precision: arch3510 ordinary FP32 MMAD has 16x16x1 parallelism; HF32 has 16x16x8. Both use storage k0=8. The caller declares inherited CTRL.HF32; nominal clock is 1.65 GHz.
assumptions.memory_path: shared HBM; independent AIC/AIV read owners use nominal INI ddr_read_rate 80/40 B/cycle per core. These memory-path supply declarations are not measured MTE2 instruction rates. Shared L2 capacity and cache behavior are not characterized.
assumptions.onchip_transfer: arch3510 nominal instruction bandwidth: MTE1 LoadData2DV2 256 B/cycle/AIC, Fixpipe local destination128 B/cycle/AIC, MTE3 UB-to-L1 128 B/cycle/AIV; UB-to-UB DataCopy uses PIPE_V at 256 payload B/cycle/AIV. Startup and shared L1 ingress are not characterized; Fixpipe-to-GM issue rate remains a declared nominal assumption.
assumptions.profile: registered SKU geometry and nominal rates
assumptions.register_capacity: Pinned arch3510 Reg tables: at most two issue slots, two data-register writes, two UB accesses and one UB store per cycle. Single-issue calls occupy both slots. ALU/special lane capacity assumes ideal dual issue; reduce/shuffle single issue. Active masked lanes impose capacity bounds only; masked instruction service, dependency latency, compiler pairing and predicate-write ports remain uncharacterized. This is not a cycle-accurate instruction schedule.
assumptions.scalar_store_queue: BF16 UB-to-GM store issue and finite queue, independently identified on Ascend950DT_9582 image c3d00a196905; data/observations/gating-probe-20261028/native-queue-holdout/parameters.json SHA256 6dd37dd1fe824e7fed73262d84f27c1aa385498fc508d3582759467348bdacfb. Train first24 address-isolation rows; heldout retained separately. This is a primitive calibration, not kernel startup or model latency. Not inherited by other SKUs or A3.
assumptions.transfer_bandwidth_precedence: explicit machine.links > explicit transfer_channels channel bandwidth > convenience bytes_per_s > same-layer Gb/s > profile effective; within a channel explicit effective > explicit calibrated > explicit derived > explicit uni_peak, and null preserves unknown/disabled semantics
assumptions.transfer_bandwidth_units: inter_node_bw_gbps/intra_node_bw_gbps are decimal Gb/s and divided by 8; inter_node_bw_bytes_per_s/intra_node_bw_bytes_per_s are B/s and win over same-layer Gb/s; transfer_channels.*_bw_gbps and Link.capacity_gbps keep the historical GB/s meaning
assumptions.transfer_channel_scope: Only d2d_intra_package, d2d_intra_node and d2d_inter_node generate device graph links. Other registered channels remain metadata; they do not override host/offload services or the P/D connector. Generated links retain per_port capacity unless semantics is explicitly declared.
assumptions.vector_issue: one FP32 lane operation per cycle unless explicitly overridden

contract_scope.mx_execution_assumption: Declared matrix compute-format work and operand-scale traffic; MX scale application and native instruction scheduling are not separately resolved. This does not infer an additional output epilogue from tensor descriptors.
